rendered:
After the high-rate step, NFA-A recovered to a capacity of ≈170 mAh g^− 1[1], against an initial slow-rate capacity of ≈184 mAh g^− 1[2]. The paper describes this recovery as similar (≈5%)[3] to the initial capacity. That label is smaller than the gap between the quoted capacities, so the stated figure should be read with that caveat.

After the same high-rate step, NFA-F recovered to a capacity of ≈138 mAh g^− 1[4], against an initial slow-rate capacity of ≈190 mAh g^− 1[5]. The paper reports this as a loss of ≈27% loss[6]. On these figures NFA-A was the most stable of the variants in this test, as the paper concludes.
